Team rules

copilot-instructions.md: a README for the robot

A short file of team rules. Copilot reads it on every chat request and review.
.github/copilot-instructions.md where it shows in the result
1Keep the code small and explicit.➞2 lines of logic in the diff
2Use only the Python standard library; add no dependencies.➞new imports: 0
3Keep current behavior unless the issue says to change it.➞test_outside_standard: fee still $18.00
4Add boundary tests for every price threshold.➞test_prime_below_75_pays: 74.99 pays $7.50
5Explain any assumption before you edit code.➞the plan in chat before the edit (slide 10)

Release day

Release day: Copilot reads the open checklist

release_checklist.txt — Notepadschematic
Courier app: release checklist
1. Unit tests are green.
2. Anna confirms: Prime threshold = $75, city zone only.
3. Feature flag is on in staging only.
4. Ola updates the support reply before the production release.
5. Compare the delivery-cost number for 24 hours after the release.
6. Roll back the flag if outside-zone fees change unexpectedly.

GenAI Basics • Lesson 07 • The Copilot Ecosystem18 / 21
Limits

Copilot sees only what you can open

Wrong account
You signed in to the wrong one, and Copilot sees the wrong files.
A secret in the chat
A password, a key, customer data: none of it goes into a request.
“Done!”
The word proves nothing. Look at the diff and the tests.
Model training: work accounts (Microsoft 365, GitHub Business and Enterprise) are not used. Personal GitHub: since 24 April 2026 your data may be used by default; switch it off in Copilot settings.
GenAI Basics • Lesson 07 • The Copilot Ecosystem19 / 21
Practice

Homework: take your feature through three Copilots

What to hand in: a public GitHub repository
courier-copilot-week/ ├── brief.md ├── delivery_fee.py ├── test_delivery_fee.py ├── checklist.md └── README.md # 3 screenshots screenshots: brief, Copilot in editor, PR + a link to one merged pull request
  • Feature: the Prime rule or your own, for example “rain: +$2 outside the zone”.
  • Tools: free ones only: GitHub Copilot Free in VS Code and Copilot Chat.
  • First switch off training on your data in GitHub settings.
  • Review: Copilot review on a PR may be paid; a human comment that you answered is enough.
  • Grading: the six checks of slide 18. Synthetic data only.
